item.title: How Medicaid affected one California House race
item.description: A Republican in California's Central Valley fended off challengers for years. But his district had a lot of people on Medicaid, and he lost by a large margin this time.

item.title: In northern Ethiopia, conflict pushes a strained healthcare system to the brink
item.description: Ethiopia's health care system was once considered a model in the region. But in the northern Tigray region, ongoing conflict has left health facilities and medical workers vulnerable to attacks.

item.title: Swing voters in swing states weigh the effect of the midterm results
item.description: These swing voters in swing states didn't all vote for Democrats, but they are all hoping for results and lower prices.

item.title: College Football Playoff will expand to 24 teams in another sea change for the sport
item.description: The College Football Playoff is expanding again. The 12-team format lasted just three years. Starting next fall, the field will expand to 24 teams in a massive moment of transformation for the sport.
item.content:encoded: The College Football Playoff is expanding again. The 12-team format lasted just three years. Starting next fall, the field will expand to 24 teams in a massive moment of transformation for the sport.

item.title: Turkey hosts world climate summit, but some critics accuse it of 'greenwashing'
item.description: Thousands of diplomats, executives and leaders are gathering in Turkey for a global climate summit. In recent years, Turkey has moved to be more eco-conscious, but some say that hasn't been enough.

item.title: Nvidia shares tumble as the company says it's investigating CEO Jensen Huang
item.description: Nvidia's share price falls after the company begins an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's alleged relationship with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy.

item.title: A promising new medicine against heart disease fails unexpectedly
item.description: Doctors expected an experimental drug that lowers a common risk factor for heart attacks would save patients' lives. The medicine made no difference.

item.title: Paraguay bank collapse hits millions
item.description: A digital bank's collapse has plunged Paraguay into crisis — cutting millions off from their money and sending the president from office to detention in a matter of days.

item.title: Scientists think they've found ancient remnants of dinosaur blood
item.description: Scientists have studied plenty of dinosaur bones, eggs and footprints. Now, some think they've found their strongest evidence yet of dinosaur blood.
